title: TD Storage on the Mac no longer signs itself out after a day
text: Until now a Mac that had not reached the CRM for 24 hours was signed out and its TD Storage folder was removed. That limit is gone: the app stays signed in until someone signs that Mac out from the Macs page. Each login can now have up to 10 Macs instead of 5. Nobody needs to reinstall: Macs already installed pick the new rule up by themselves.
points: Signing a Mac out from the Macs signed in page still cuts it off at once
Keep FileVault on for any Mac that holds the files
The time limit can still be set again from the settings if it is ever needed

steps.name: Mac stays closed or offline for days
steps.detail: Before: signed out after 24 hours. Now: nothing happens

steps.name: Mac opens again
steps.detail: It reconnects and the TD Storage folder is still there

steps.name: Lost or stolen Mac
steps.detail: Sign it out from the Macs signed in page
